main.description: Get a specific cart sent by the authenticated user, including resolved item and subscription records. One of `uri`, `itemUri`, or `subscriptionUri` is required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the cart record. Takes precedence over itemUri and subscriptionUri.

itemUri.description: AT-URI of an item record. Returns the cart that contains this item. Ignored if uri is provided.

subscriptionUri.description: AT-URI of a subscription record. Returns the cart that contains this subscription. Ignored if uri or itemUri is provided.

checkoutUrl.description: Checkout URL, only present when cart status is open

items.description: Resolved item records referenced by this cart

subscriptions.description: Resolved subscription records referenced by this cart
